# Array-operator vector forms run only when their archsimd feature check
# is true and take the scalar form when it is false. The guard dominates
# the vector block, the feature-false jump targets the scalar loop, and
# disabling the feature still matches the scalar oracle through that path.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'array gate needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOAMD64=v1

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x8$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'CALL.*X86Features\.AVX\(SB\)'
stdout 'VADDPS'
stdout '(?s)X86Features\.AVX.*ADDSS'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.mulF64x2$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'CALL.*X86Features\.AVX\(SB\)'
stdout 'VMULPD'
stdout '(?s)X86Features\.AVX.*MULSD'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x16$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'CALL.*X86Features\.AVX512\(SB\)'
stdout 'VADDPS'
stdout '(?s)X86Features\.AVX512.*ADDSS'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x8$' $WORK/exe
stdout '(?s)CALL simd/archsimd\.X86Features\.AVX\(SB\).*TESTL AL, AL.*JE'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x16$' $WORK/exe
stdout '(?s)CALL simd/archsimd\.X86Features\.AVX512\(SB\).*TESTL AL, AL.*JE'

env GODEBUG=cpu.avx=off
logos run .
stdout '^avx false$'
stdout '^sums ok$'

env GODEBUG=cpu.avx512f=off
logos run .
stdout '^avx512 false$'
stdout '^sums ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arraygate

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"simd/archsimd"
)

//go:noinline
func addF32x8(a, b [8]float32) [8]float32 { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func mulF64x2(a, b [2]float64) [2]float64 { return a * b }

//go:noinline
func addF32x16(a, b [16]float32) [16]float32 { return a + b }

func oracleAdd8(a, b [8]float32) [8]float32 {
	var r [8]float32
	for i := range a {
		r[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
	return r
}

func oracleMul2(a, b [2]float64) [2]float64 {
	var r [2]float64
	for i := range a {
		r[i] = a[i] * b[i]
	}
	return r
}

func oracleAdd16(a, b [16]float32) [16]float32 {
	var r [16]float32
	for i := range a {
		r[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
	return r
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("avx", archsimd.X86.AVX())
	fmt.Println("avx512", archsimd.X86.AVX512())
	var a, b [8]float32
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = float32(i*3 - 20)
		b[i] = float32(i*2 + 1)
	}
	if addF32x8(a, b) != oracleAdd8(a, b) {
		panic("f32x8 add mismatch")
	}
	var c, d [2]float64
	for i := range c {
		c[i] = float64(i) + 0.5
		d[i] = float64(8 - i)
	}
	if mulF64x2(c, d) != oracleMul2(c, d) {
		panic("f64x2 mul mismatch")
	}
	var e, f [16]float32
	for i := range e {
		e[i] = float32(i*7 - 100)
		f[i] = float32(i*3 + 1)
	}
	if addF32x16(e, f) != oracleAdd16(e, f) {
		panic("f32x16 add mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}
